about: 회계 II › 계약관리 › 회계/판매일괄반영 [일부반영](E060906, 2026-10-13 원본 실측 — QA회계2-청구거래처 청구 -4(2 × 40,000) · -5(1 × 40,000)): 거래처 줄 적요 '항목명 외 1건'. 아무것도 안 고르고 [일부반영] → '알림' '자료를 1개 선택 시에만 가능합니다.'. 거래처를 골라 [일부반영] → '일괄회계반영' 창 줄마다 □, 한 줄만 골라 [매출전표 I] → 그 줄 금액만 전표(적요 항목명), 저장하면 격자에 나머지 줄만 남는다. 만든 자료는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 거래처 · 계약항목 · 계약 · 청구자료 두 장(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const A=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,{method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async(r)=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));const bs=(await A('GET','/contract-bills?from=2020-01-01&to=2099-12-31')).body||[];const mine=bs.filter((b)=>JSON.stringify(b).includes('QA회계2-일부'));for(const b of mine)if(b.lines.some((l)=>l.accountingLinked))await A('POST','/contract-bills/'+b.id+'/unreflect');if(mine.length)await A('POST','/contract-bills/delete',{ids:mine.map((b)=>b.id)});const cs=(await A('GET','/billing-contracts')).body;const mc=(Array.isArray(cs)?cs:cs.rows||[]).filter((c)=>c.name==='QA회계2-일부반영계약').map((c)=>c.id);if(mc.length)await A('POST','/billing-contracts/delete',{ids:mc});for(const i of ((await A('GET','/contract-items')).body||[]).filter((x)=>x.name==='QA회계2-일부항목'))await A('DELETE','/contract-items/'+i.id);for(const x of ((await A('GET','/partners')).body||[]).filter((x)=>x.name==='QA회계2-일부반영거래처'))await A('DELETE','/partners/'+x.id);return true})()

js:(async()=>{const c='Q'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);const p=(await window.__api('POST','/partners',{code:'QR'+String(Date.now()).slice(-5),name:'QA회계2-일부반영거래처',type:'CUSTOMER'})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('pId',p.id);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-일부항목',unitPrice:10000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'PERIODIC',salesAccountId:null})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const bc=(await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-일부반영계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:ymd.slice(5,7),quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',bc.id);const mk=async(q)=>(await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills',{billDate:ymd,vatType:'세금계산서',byPartner:false,lines:[{contractLineId:bc.lines[0].id,billMonth:ymd.slice(0,7),quantity:q,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:q*10000,vatAmount:q*1000,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body[0];const b1=await mk(2);const b2=await mk(1);sessionStorage.setItem('b1',b1.id);sessionStorage.setItem('b2',b2.id);sessionStorage.setItem('b2no',b2.docNo);return b1.id+' '+b2.id})()

js:(async()=>{const bills=(await window.__api('GET','/contract-bills')).body;const b2=bills.find((b)=>b.id===Number(sessionStorage.getItem('b2')));const r1=await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills/'+b2.id+'/unreflect');const a=await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills/delete',{ids:[Number(sessionStorage.getItem('b1')),Number(sessionStorage.getItem('b2'))]});const b=await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts/delete',{ids:[Number(sessionStorage.getItem('bcId'))]});const c=await window.__api('DELETE','/contract-items/'+sessionStorage.getItem('ciId'));const d=await window.__api('DELETE','/partners/'+sessionStorage.getItem('pId'));return r1.status+' '+a.status+' '+b.status+' '+c.status+' '+d.status})()
